info.description: Styling options for any text element (headings, subheadings, labels, etc.)

textStyle.description: Text appearance: default (solid theme color), gradient (color transition), two-tone (accent word + main text in different colors)

gradientDirection.description: Gradient direction (only used when textStyle is gradient): diagonal (bottom-right), horizontal (left-right), vertical (top-bottom), radial (center outward)

customGradient.description: Optional custom gradient colors (overrides default theme gradients). Leave empty to use theme colors.
